([theinfatuation.com](https://www.theinfatuation.com/london/reviews/mildreds?utm_source=openai))

- Multiple review platforms and guides (TripAdvisor, HappyCow, Wanderlog and others) repeatedly report the restaurant is often busy/crowded and can be noisy at peak times (supports lower conversation score and the "buzzing" energy). - Longstanding Soho presence and consistent editorial attention → Trendy + Neighborhood vibes (popular, iconic local spot). ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/food/2022/apr/22/mildreds-london-wc1-unapologetic-and-utterly-un-preachy-restaurant-review?utm_source=openai))
